cast.speaker: Dexter P
cast.description: Male voice in his late teens, deep smooth velvety baritone, posh British accent, theatrical, dramatic, slow and breathy, lovestruck.

cast.speaker: Milo P
cast.description: Male voice in his late teens, high-pitched squeaky nasal American voice, fast, anxious, twitchy, easily flustered.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter P
dialogue_lines.text: Do you remember when we played Catten with Bobby last Friday?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Do you remember when we played Catten with Bobby last Friday?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo P
dialogue_lines.text: Yeah. Technically I lost, because he built the longest road and refused to trade me a single sheep. It's a tyranny.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Yeah. Technically I lost, because he built the longest road and refused to trade me a single sheep. It's a tyranny.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter P
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> Tell me... do you not feel something... when you watch him play like that?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Tell me... do you not feel something... when you watch him play like that?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo P
dialogue_lines.text: Wha... what? Feel what? Like, indigestion? I did eat a lot of pretzels.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Wha... what? Feel what? Like, indigestion? I did eat a lot of pretzels.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter P
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... magnificent road of his. <sigh> And the way he murmurs, ore for wheat.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... magnificent road of his.  And the way he murmurs, ore for wheat.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo P
dialogue_lines.text: I... guess? His settlement placement is, uh, statistically very good?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I... guess? His settlement placement is, uh, statistically very good?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter P
dialogue_lines.text: <gasp> And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber? <whisper> I had to leave the room.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber?  I had to leave the room.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo P
dialogue_lines.text: <gulp> Dude. We were playing in your room.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Dude. We were playing in your room.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter P
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> So... do you also find him sexy when he plays Catten?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: So... do you also find him sexy when he plays Catten?
